thread:
Hannah T.: opened PR to tighten SOC2 section + add an 'Audit logs & retention' how-to. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/970

Diego R.: Quick note: legal asked us to avoid active voice (e.g., "we store"). Use neutral phrasing like 'audit logs are retained per admin-configured policies'.

Lena K.: Adding a short migration checklist for Private customers (on-prem & VPC): validate endpoint paths, confirm webhook URLs, rotate service keys after cutover. I'll draft it.

Hannah T.: thx Lena. Also backend changed the export API path in staging -> `/v1/admin/audit-logs` (old: `/v1/auditlogs`). Examples need updating.

Diego R.: Can we include a Ruby SDK snippet? Most customers ask for Python/JS, but a few law firms use Ruby. Keep it tiny.

Lena K.: Draft Ruby snippet:
```ruby
# list audit logs (admin)
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['RW_TOKEN'])
client.admin.audit_logs.list(start_time: '2025-06-01T00:00:00Z', per_page: 100)
```
Will add to Examples. (marked code fence as ruby)

infra-sre: please add a one-line curl smoke test for SRE: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/audit-logs?page=1"`

Hannah T.: Added curl and a tiny note about rate limits for exports. Also swapped internal SOC2 mapping link to the published PDF: https://redwood-inference.com/compliance/soc2-mapping.pdf

compliance-bot: Auto-scan: flagged phrase 'we keep logs' on line 42. Suggest rewrite to neutral/configurable language. Also lint: missing code-block language on one snippet.

Diego R.: Fixed the flagged phrasing and added the ruby fence language. Also included a short note: "Retention may be constrained by applicable law or contract."

Lena K.: I'll take a final pass for migration steps and add checklist items for Dedicated customers: test endpoint, rotate keys, update docs in onboarding playbook. Assigning back to @Hannah T. for final merge. :white_check_mark:
